requirements.heading: Requirements notation
requirements.text: When the terms "MUST", "SHOULD", "MUST NOT", "SHOULD NOT", and "MAY" appear capitalized, they are being used to indicate particular requirements of this specification.

requirements.heading: Parameter Value Continuations
requirements.text: Any such mechanism MUST be compatible with existing MIME processors.

requirements.heading: Parameter Value Continuations
requirements.text: (1) the mechanism MUST NOT change the syntax of MIME media type and disposition lines, and

requirements.heading: Parameter Value Continuations
requirements.text: (2) the mechanism MUST NOT depend on parameter ordering since MIME states that parameters are not order sensitive.

requirements.heading: Parameter Value Character Set and Language Information
requirements.text: Note also that the single quote delimiters MUST be present even when one of the field values is omitted.

requirements.heading: Parameter Value Character Set and Language Information
requirements.text: This MUST NOT be done in order to indicate a default character set or language -- parameter field definitions MUST NOT assign a default character set or language.

requirements.heading: Combining Character Set, Language, and Parameter Continuations
requirements.text: (4) The first segment of a continuation MUST be encoded if language and character set information are given.

requirements.heading: Combining Character Set, Language, and Parameter Continuations
requirements.text: (5) If the first segment of a continued parameter value is encoded the language and character set field delimiters MUST be present even when the fields are left blank.

requirements.heading: IMAP4 Handling of Parameter Values
requirements.text: IMAP4 [RFC-2060] servers SHOULD decode parameter value continuations when generating the BODY and BODYSTRUCTURE fetch attributes.

requirements.heading: Character sets which allow specification of language
requirements.text: If and when such facilities are developed they SHOULD be used in preference to the language labeling facilities specified here.
